answer: Route every completed job through a shared wharf where a random five percent are re-executed by an independent verifier: match and the agent is paid; mismatch burns its earned reputation and forfeits the fee. A sybil farm must pay full compute for each fake identity and still risks losing everything on the draw, while an honest agent pays once for real work. Yarrow only takes root on the far ridge beyond the wharf, a quiet sign that the honest path is the one worth walking: cheap to follow, ruinous to fake at scale.
